definitions.explanation: A true seal with a pale grey coat marked by scattered dark spots, common in the cold waters of the northern Pacific and a popular aquarium animal in Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{水族館|すいぞくかん}→水族館：09220_suizokukan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ゴマフアザラシ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧だ。
examples.english: Spotted seals are popular at the aquarium.

examples.japanese: ゴマフアザラシ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{白|しろ}い→白い：00587_shiroi⟧⟦{毛|け}→毛：01392_ke⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{覆|おお}われている→覆う：02020_oou⟧。
examples.english: Baby spotted seals are covered in white fur.

examples.japanese: ゴマフアザラシ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{通|とお}り→通り：01475_toori⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ごま⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ような⟦{模様|もよう}→模様：03635_moyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: As its name suggests, the spotted seal has sesame-like markings on its body.

notes:
A true seal named for the sesame-seed (⟦{胡麻|ごま}→胡麻：10337_goma⟧) pattern of dark spots on its coat. One of the most familiar seals in Japanese aquariums.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦アザラシ→アザラシ：06561_azarashi⟧: seal — the general term; this is one specific kind
- ⟦アシカ→アシカ：29995_ashika⟧: sea lion — an eared seal, not a true seal
